loan.limitedBy.rule: Limit set by the {limit}% standard rule.
loan.risk: Predicted risk of not repaying: {level} ({risk}%; average real loan: {base}%)
loan.how.title: How is this calculated?
loan.how.model: Risk model trained on {rows} real personal loans from Lending Club (USA, {from}–{to}). No Mauritian loan dataset is publicly available; with Bank of Mauritius MCIB data the same model could be retrained locally.
loan.how.search: We try loan amounts in steps of Rs 5,000 at your rate and term, using your income, existing repayments and missed payments. The AI estimate is the biggest amount whose predicted risk is at or below the average ({base}%) and whose repayment stays under {cap}% of your income. Your answer is the lower of this and the {limit}% rule.
loan.how.noModel: The risk model isn't available right now, so only the {limit}% standard rule was used.
loan.formula: Standard rule (repayments up to {limit}% of income, {rate}% for {years} years): about {amount}.
loan.aiUnavailable: The AI model isn't available right now, so this is the standard rule.

game.label: Game 1
game.title: Budget Challenge
game.subtitle: Learn to budget with fictional scenarios
game.eventCost: {category} now needs {amount} more. Take it from wants or unallocated money, or you lose points.
game.adjustOnce: You can adjust your budget once, then submit.
game.over: Over your income by {amount}: lower some amounts to submit.
game.badAmount: Amounts must be numbers of 0 or more.
game.xpAlready: XP for this game was already given.
game.levelStory.1: You're a student in Rose-Hill with Rs 15,000 a month from family and a small job. Food, bus, phone and study come first.
game.levelStory.2: Your first job in Port Louis pays Rs 30,000. You help at home and repay a loan of Rs 2,500 every month.
game.levelStory.3: You live alone and earn Rs 45,000. Rent (Rs 12,000) and your loan (Rs 3,000) are fixed every month.
game.event.bus_fare: Bus fares go up: transport costs {amount} more this month.
game.event.small_bonus: Good work! You get a bonus of {amount}.
game.tip.overspend: You planned {over} more than your income.
game.tip.essential_short: {category} needs at least {min}: essentials come first.
game.tip.savings_low: Try to save at least {target} (10% of income).
game.tip.event_failed: After the surprise, {category} needed more money ({amount}) and your budget didn't cover it.
game.tip.unassigned: {left} is left unallocated. Giving it a purpose, like savings or an emergency fund, helps.
game.tip.great: Perfect budget! Every rupee has a job.
error.GAME_UNKNOWN_CATEGORY: That category isn't part of this level.
error.GAME_NOT_FOUND: Game not found. Start a new one.
error.GAME_FINAL_NEEDED: You already adjusted once: submit your final budget.
error.GAME_EVENT_PENDING: Submit your first budget to see the surprise event.
